assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE precisely aligned six-view orthographic texture projection atlas for a North Minzu University clock tower 3D mesh.
Reference 1: the isolated rendered clock tower defines building identity and material appearance. Reference 2: actual aerial photo is the authoritative front architecture, not its landscape or labels.
Output: a single high-resolution LANDSCAPE image divided into EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, no gutters or borders, perfectly aligned cell seams at x=1/3,2/3 and y=1/2. Each cell is one orthographic building elevation. This is an asset baking atlas, not a presentation diagram; no labels/text/marks anywhere.
TOP LEFT cell: strict orthographic FRONT elevation, camera level and parallel, zero perspective, no roof surfaces visible. The tower centered at x=50%, identical left/right low wings, cream stone cladding, tall blue-gray vertical glazed central tower, white straight mullions, red horizontal bands, red pyramidal roof cap and long white spire. The full tower and wings fill approx 92% cell width and 94% cell height, all bases exactly horizontal at 97% cell height, tower tip at 3%.
TOP MIDDLE cell: strict BACK elevation of the SAME building, precisely same bounding dimensions and baseline, plausibly complete hidden surfaces with same cream/red palette and straight grid of windows. No random additional towers.
TOP RIGHT cell: strict LEFT side elevation, profile centered, same height and baseline. Its side footprint is narrow relative to whole front width; object fills the whole cell width for texture projection normalization.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: strict RIGHT side elevation, same normalized width/height and baseline as left profile, architecturally consistent with the same building.
BOTTOM MIDDLE cell: true TOP-DOWN roof projection, zero perspective, whole low wing roofs and central tower cap laid out consistently in plan. Gray flat roof, parapets, red cap. Fit the footprint into 92% cell width and height with 4% white margin.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: fill with seamless pale ivory wall-stone material only, subtle rectilinear tile joints.
Important: every elevation has perfectly vertical window columns and perfectly horizontal floor bands, no camera tilt, no vanishing points, no cast shadows, no buildings floating at different baselines. Orthographic photographic material appearance with clean straight architectural details, neutral unbaked diffuse lighting, pure white background outside building silhouettes. No surrounding campus, trees, roads, sky, people, logos, watermark. Keep the whole roof cap and spire inside the frame. Building is about 4 floors at each wing, many narrow rows in the central tower; preserve recognizable actual main-building identity. Hidden sides are plausible AI completion.
assets.method: AI生成；真实照片只作外观参考，隐藏细节估算
